frontend: actual legacy Lexer token stream and actual Parser with optional physical-origin callbacks
lexer_selection: fixed legacy scanner under every compiler feature configuration; no eager logos scan
normal_frontend_equivalence: normal Logos frontend origin parity is not claimed; ordinary Lexer::new behavior remains configured by its feature
scope: one exact UTF-8 physical buffer; no import resolution, typecheck, solver or source execution
identity: separate canonical declaration and clause identities from original names, typed lexical scopes and exact byte ranges; no transformed-AST name reconstruction
function_region_rule: Only a Function token immediately followed by an Identifier token at the same or lower physical delimiter depth begins a new region. Anonymous function/type tokens followed by LeftParen and nested declaration tokens do not reset an outer region. The prefix before the first named function is also bounded. This supplemental metadata-only limit is checked after original global preflight and lexical completion; error.limit is expression-segment-tokens.
input_policy: stable owned filesystem: reject final symlinks and nonregular paths before open; recheck opened regular handle and use bounded read; concurrent path replacement/TOCTOU protection is excluded
whole_unit_rejection: no accepted origin containers after lexical incompletion, embedded NUL, parse/recovery failure, unsupported profile grammar or resource excess
claim_limit: physical metadata only; no binding-instance resolution, source authentication, proof eligibility, completeness, qualification or certification claim
